Alexandra Alexandrovna Shubladze (Russian: Александра
Александровна Шубладзе , born 6 September 2005) is a Russian tennis player. [ 1 ] Shubladze has career-high WTA rankings of 315 in singles and 366 in doubles, both achieved 21 October 2024. [ 2 ] She won her first W50 title in January 2024 at an ITF event in Antalya in the doubles draw, partnering Anastasiia Gureva .
